limitations: Exactly three iid categorical draws; does not address longer samples, heterogeneous sampling or dependence. Classical equivalent results may be unindexed; independent external review not performed.
scientific_integrity: An analytic universal proof via a sharp centered cubic inequality and an exact-rational six-category counterexample; standalone checks are supporting diagnostics, not an infinite proof.
title: A sharp five-category Poisson-binomial threshold for three-draw richness
